title: Let the payout rules run without the bank

cases.says: approved claims are paid through the transfers the policy was given, in order, and each payment is recorded with its reference
a declined or zero claim is not paid and is recorded in the audit trail the policy was given, not one looked up elsewhere
building the policy with no transfers fails right there with NullPointerException, instead of falling back to the production bank
building the policy with no audit trail fails right there with NullPointerException, not at the first payout

origin.section: A Constructor Parameter Turns a Forgotten Dependency Into a Compile Error
